accountEmailFixed: Your sign-in identity; it can't change.
linkSsoDescription: Link your account at an identity provider so you can sign in through it.
linkSsoErrorAlreadyLinked: Your account is already linked to your organization's identity provider.
linkSsoErrorNoConnection: Single sign-on is not set up for your email domain. Contact your administrator.
linkSsoErrorNotAllowed: This account cannot link single sign-on itself. Ask a superuser to link it.
linkSsoErrorPasswordRequired: You signed in through single sign-on. Sign in with your password to link an account.
linkSsoExplain: You will continue to the identity provider your organization set up for your email domain. Sign in there with the same email address as this account.
linkSsoSessionEnded: Linking needs a recent sign-in with your password. Sign in again, then link the account.
noTenantMemberships: You hold no tenant memberships. Add one from Identities to enter a tenant.
